pairs.description_left: Total fast-ion parallel pressure, summed over all fast-ion species and charge states, is the gyrotropic stress component along the local magnetic field.
pairs.description_right: Total fast-ion perpendicular pressure, summed over all fast-ion species and charge states, is the gyrotropic stress component perpendicular to the local magnetic field.

pairs.description_left: Signed coordinate of each aperture-outline vertex along the aperture’s first local tangential axis, defining its location in the object-local cross-sectional geometry.
pairs.description_right: Signed coordinate of each aperture-outline vertex along the aperture’s second local tangential axis, defining its location in the object-local cross-sectional geometry.

pairs.description_left: Signed coordinate of a soft X-ray detector outline vertex along the first local tangential (X1) axis of the detector-local two-dimensional Cartesian frame.
pairs.description_right: Signed coordinate of a soft X-ray detector outline vertex along the second local tangential (X2) axis of the detector-local right-handed Cartesian frame.

pairs.description_left: Poloidal component of the conventional electric-current density attributed to turbulence-driven anomalous transport in a plasma.
pairs.description_right: Toroidal component of the conventional electric-current density attributed to turbulence-driven anomalous transport in a plasma.

pairs.description_left: Poloidal component of the electric current carried by halo plasma on open magnetic field lines between the last closed flux surface and first wall during a disruption.
pairs.description_right: Toroidal component of the electric current carried by halo plasma on open magnetic field lines between the last closed flux surface and first wall during a disruption.

pairs.description_left: The imaginary part of the complex poloidal component of the first-order perturbed plasma magnetic-field eigenfunction for a single toroidal Fourier mode in linear MHD stability analysis.
pairs.description_right: Imaginary part of the complex toroidal component of the first-order plasma magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction for a single toroidal Fourier mode in linear MHD stability analysis.

pairs.description_left: Complex poloidal component of the first-order magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction in the current-free vacuum region outside the plasma boundary, for a single toroidal Fourier mode in linear MHD stability analysis.
pairs.description_right: Toroidal component of the complex first-order magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction in the current-free vacuum region outside the plasma, resolved for a single toroidal Fourier mode number in linear MHD stability analysis.

pairs.description_left: Angular-momentum source per unit volume generated by the Lorentz force, averaged over a magnetic flux surface for counter-passing particles.
pairs.description_right: Angular-momentum source per unit volume generated by the Lorentz force, averaged over a magnetic flux surface for trapped particles.

pairs.description_left: Dimensionless parallel momentum flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming upper bound on neutral-particle momentum-flux density along the magnetic field in edge-plasma transport closures.
pairs.description_right: Dimensionless poloidal momentum flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming upper bound on neutral-particle momentum-flux density in edge-plasma transport closures.

pairs.description_left: Dimensionless parallel momentum flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming upper bound on neutral-particle momentum-flux density along the magnetic field in edge-plasma transport closures.
pairs.description_right: Dimensionless vertical momentum flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming upper bound on neutral-particle momentum-flux density in edge-plasma transport closures.

pairs.description_left: Rate of transport of linear momentum per unit area across an oriented plasma surface, restricted to the diamagnetic contribution for a neutral species in a specified internal state.
pairs.description_right: Rate of transport of linear momentum per unit area across an oriented surface, summed over charged plasma populations and excluding neutral transport.

pairs.description_left: Local volumetric rate of neutron production from deuterium-deuterium fusion reactions, giving the spatial distribution of D-D neutron emission per unit volume at each point in the plasma.
pairs.description_right: Local volumetric rate of neutron production from deuterium-tritium fusion reactions, giving the spatial distribution of D-T neutron emission per unit volume at each point in the plasma.

pairs.description_left: Volumetric Coulomb-collisional energy-transfer rate received by thermal ions of a specified charge state from the co-passing component of a fast-particle distribution.
pairs.description_right: Volumetric rate of Coulomb-collisional kinetic-energy transfer to thermal ions of a specified charge state from the counter-passing guiding-center orbit class of non-Maxwellian source particles.

pairs.description_left: Local number density of fast, non-thermal ions of a specified species at a plasma point, summed over all ionic charge states.
pairs.description_right: Local number density of thermal (Maxwellian) ions of a specified species at a plasma point, summed over all ionic charge states.

pairs.description_left: Directional electron particle diffusion coefficient linking the parallel diffusive electron flux to the electron density gradient in a magnetized plasma.
pairs.description_right: Directional electron particle diffusion coefficient linking the poloidal diffusive electron flux to the electron density gradient in a magnetized plasma.

pairs.description_left: Diffusion coefficient relating the diffusive parallel ion momentum flux to the local parallel ion momentum gradient, expressing down-gradient redistribution within the total ion population summed over charge states.
pairs.description_right: Diffusion coefficient relating the diffusive poloidal ion momentum flux to the local poloidal ion momentum density gradient, expressing down-gradient redistribution within the total ion population summed over charge states.

pairs.description_left: Parallel component of the area-normalized momentum source for the neutral population in the edge plasma, summed over all neutral states. Its sign distinguishes momentum transfer along and opposite to the local magnetic-field direction.
pairs.description_right: Poloidal component of the area-normalized momentum source for the neutral population in the edge plasma, summed over all neutral states. Its sign distinguishes neutral momentum transfer along and opposite to the local poloidal direction.

pairs.description_left: Effective parallel particle diffusivity for neutral species, relating neutral-particle spreading to the local neutral number-density gradient.
pairs.description_right: Effective poloidal particle diffusivity for neutral species, relating neutral-particle spreading to the local neutral number-density gradient.
